bottleneck: Run003 launched AvalancheGo but every VM plugin failed to load libSPDZ.so because subprocess startup strips LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
causal_hypothesis: Registering the already pinned MP-SPDZ/PQC-OpenSSL paths in the image loader cache permits the exact same VM bytes to run under the plugin's empty environment.
single_intended_change: Derived runtime image adds only /etc/ld.so.conf.d/00-qomm-runtime.conf and ldconfig output; preserve exact VM/driver/proof/script bytes, UID10001 and private service-home tmpfs.
baseline: cocode-live-avalanche-003: blocked, primary0, 194.693 seconds; five VM loader failures and ANR health timeout.
evaluation_population: One fresh isolated five-validator chain, frozen native003 fill/no-fill proofs, all chunks and canonical negatives, one validator restart; same host is not independent operators.
likely_prediction_error: The first actual VM RPC, consensus or large-state path reveals a boundary not reached by previous loader-blocked attempts.
rejection_rule: Any missing real acceptance, differing roots, absent restart readback, changed proof parameters, non-semantic error counted as rejection or existing deployment mutation blocks acceptance.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only; no security certification, independent operators, full application migration or production promotion.
network_isolation: Fresh network-none container; read-only image plus private service-home tmpfs; loopback validators; no published ports; public proof mount read-only; no prior service state.
